Hi Alicia — appreciate the materials and the clear asks. Short answers up front, then details:

- Temporary Flex lift: yes, we support a 30-day burst into Flex via a temporary seat-burst (no long-term reserved commitment required). There are two constraints: max burst = 60% of your committed Compact throughput, and we need a 72-hour notice to provision additional GPU capacity for predictable latency SLOs.

- Feature portability: entitlements are mostly configurable, but two features you called out require backing capacity (prefix/KV cache + structured-output validation) that we guard via add-on entitlements for Flex. That said, for pilot->Flex transitions we can issue a temporary feature port (30 days) at no extra charge once we have a signed amendment to the pilot addendum (procurement still signs). After the temporary window ends, either the features revert or the customer converts to the Flex add-on.

I'll outline the path and the approvals below so procurement has something to hand to legal.
